about: What otter.txt reads into. The file is written by hand in the layout of Otter's TXT export as Otter's help centre shows it in its article on exporting conversations: a header line of a name, two spaces and a time, with two spaces after the time; the paragraph; a blank line; and the closing line Otter adds. It is not an export: replace it with a real one when one is at hand.

turns.text: Good morning. Shall we start with the budget?
Yes. Travel is ten percent over plan.
Can we move the offsite to May?
May works, and the venue holds forty people.
Then book it. Research & design present first.
Agreed. I will send the notes today.
